name: PointCast Constellation
description: The register of satellites — sibling sites in the same practice, built from the same house, each with its own address. PointCast is the broadcast; these are the towns it can see from the roof. The register exists because the satellites were invisible to the machine layer: a dozen live properties shipped in summer 2026 that /agents.json never mentioned.

model.name: house / network
model.summary: Direction, not contract: value splits at the edge — half to the house (Standard Time), half to the network — transparent on Tezos. The register is the membership roll; the till is the settlement rail, still in design.

peering.note: A satellite that publishes its own pointcast-peer well-known file becomes an addressable peer under pcp-1.0. The register lists satellites either way — listing is curation, peering is protocol.

satellites.name: Standard Time
satellites.description: An on-chain agency in El Segundo — the house side of the house/network model. Council treasury on a TzSafe multisig.

satellites.name: tez-cast
satellites.description: Your wallet, broadcasting. Append-only casts from any Tezos wallet — the tower other satellites read instead of deploying their own state.

satellites.name: stampz
satellites.description: Proof you showed up. Soulbound stamps plus public one-sheet pages, read straight off the broadcast tower — shipped with zero new contracts.

satellites.name: Rally
satellites.description: Pickleball, on the record. Countersigned matches feed an on-chain Elo desk; courts carry oracle-vouched geo-stamps.

satellites.name: drum
satellites.description: The token you earn by drumming. Every hit is a DRUM — fungible FA2, permissionless batch-claim mint, no admin.

satellites.name: susu
satellites.description: The savings circle. ROSCA rounds that hold 0ꜩ between rounds, the fountain's daily equal split, and made-whole completion stamps.

satellites.name: the reservoir
satellites.description: The compute susu. Soulbound seats, pooled dues, memo-tagged council draws that buy compute for the club.

satellites.name: dotpath
satellites.description: Your links, minted. Link-in-bio as a Tezos token with a nounish face — handle in, Noun out.

satellites.name: THAS HER
satellites.description: The ladies pickleball monthly. A riso zine with self-serve league ratings signed from any Tezos wallet.

satellites.name: Tezos Passport
satellites.description: Make a moment. Keep its story. Wallet-story passports — badges that remember why they were minted.

satellites.name: Bell & Signal
satellites.description: A small sound foundry. Campanological bells cast as code — eleven castings and counting, each with its founding law.

satellites.name: Stillwater
satellites.description: Five quiet audio instruments — Ember, Stratum, Bellcount, Murmur, Tidepool. Everything synthesized live; nothing sampled.

satellites.name: The Grey Hour
satellites.description: Wizard meditation. A procedural WebGL and WebAudio twilight for sitting still in.

satellites.name: Practical Life
satellites.description: Nine working daily-living instruments from the UES Extension — the civic-utility sibling of the El Segundo school.

satellites.name: NOUN SIGNAL
satellites.description: Deterministic Nouns for radio stations and mesh nodes — a station and node generator for the network's call signs.

satellites.name: PHOSPHOR
satellites.description: Light, obedient. A 262k-particle WebGL2 VFX instrument with a campaign desk.

satellites.name: moodygold
satellites.description: Abstract soundscapes. Already carried on the apps shelf; listed here so the roll is complete.

satellites.name: offbalance
satellites.description: Good Feels El Segundo. Already carried on the apps shelf; listed here so the roll is complete.
